Medical countermeasures alone do not stop outbreaks.  In "Lessons from the Bundibugyo outbreak for the Americas" in the latest edition of  The Lancet Regional Health – Americas, Sabin's  Vice President for Vaccine Epidemiology Denise Garrett, MD, MSc and President of Global Immunization Rebecca Martin note that while the #Bundibugyo outbreak is far from the Americas, the realities on the ground hit close to home for a region that also grapples with evolving disease risks.  Spread of diseases like dengue, Oropouche, and yellow fever "all point to the same critical  need: countries require preparedness systems that can detect, verify, and respond to evolving risks before they become larger emergencies."  Here's how preparedness systems can be built before an outbreak begins.⤵️  https://ow.ly/ABOO50ZmrOb

Preparation is key to success — and representatives from 10 African countries attending the November 2025 Hexavalent Vaccine Early Adopters Workshop in Senegal, co-convened by Sabin and WHO AFRO, learned how to prepare for the switch from pentavalent +IPV to hexavalent vaccines through peers who had already made the transition.  The hexavalent vaccine protects against six diseases in a single shot — improving efficiency and saving lives.   Such Regional Peer Learning models can help strengthen policy and operational readiness for countries at different stages of decision-making, planning, and implementation for vaccine introductions and switches.   See the evidence-based insights surfaced from this workshop in a recently released paper, co-authored by Sabin, WHO Afro, Hexavalent Vaccine (Switch) Assessment Consortium (HeVAC) partners, and workshop participants, in the journal Vaccines ⤵️ https://ow.ly/8sMq50ZnxS6

In 2025, the number of zero-dose children (children who have not received any routine childhood immunization) declined by 750,000 globally, and the percentage of girls who have received at least one dose of the HPV vaccine rose to one-third, according to data released today in the annual World Health Organization-UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC).  See more about the successes and opportunities in global vaccination coverage — and a look ahead —in this article from Health Policy Watch ⤵️ https://ow.ly/P95w50ZnWxf
